description: This file contains functions and classes for estimating runtime of collective operations in PyTorch using CUDA events, including benchmarking, caching, and logging of estimations and benchmarks within the FX graph passes.

methods.name: _format_csv
methods.description: Formats headers and rows into a CSV string.

methods.name: _get_collective_key
methods.description: Generates a unique key for a collective node including group info and tensor size.

methods.name: _get_collective_estimations
methods.description: Returns NCCL and Inductor estimated runtimes for a collective node.

methods.name: get_cached_runtime
methods.description: Retrieves cached runtime for a given key.

methods.name: set_cached_runtime
methods.description: Stores runtime in cache for a given key.

methods.name: get_hint
methods.description: Extracts size hint from symbolic or concrete tensor dimensions.

methods.name: can_benchmark_collective
methods.description: Checks if collective benchmarking is possible (not in fake process group).

methods.name: _median
methods.description: Calculates median of a list of numbers.

methods.name: _benchmark_collective_with_cuda_events_impl
methods.description: Performs CUDA event-based benchmarking of a collective node, returning median runtime.

methods.name: benchmark_collective_with_cuda_events
methods.description: Public API to benchmark a collective node with CUDA events, returning runtime and cache key.

methods.name: benchmark_collective_with_cuda_events_impl
methods.description: Internal implementation for CUDA event-based benchmarking of a collective node.

methods.name: _log_compute_estimations
methods.description: Logs comparison of benchmarked vs analytical runtime estimations for compute nodes.

methods.name: _log_graph_collective_benchmarks
methods.description: Logs benchmarks for collective nodes in a FX graph module.

methods.name: _log_collective_benchmarks
methods.description: Logs estimations and benchmarks for a list of collective nodes, including diff ratios.
